versions.subject: Merge PR #4567 from @netgrain - Adding analytics for CVE-2023-22518
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
        - '\tomcat8.exe'
        - '\tomcat9.exe'
        - '\tomcat10.exe'
    ParentCommandLine|contains: 'confluence'
selection_child:
    # Note: Only children associated with known campaigns
    - Image|endswith:
          - '\cmd.exe'
          - '\powershell.exe'
    - OriginalFileName:
          - 'Cmd.Exe'
          - 'PowerShell.EXE'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ParentImage IN ("*\\tomcat8.exe", "*\\tomcat9.exe", "*\\tomcat10.exe") ParentCommandLine="*confluence*" Image IN ("*\\cmd.exe", "*\\powershell.exe") OR OriginalFileName IN ("Cmd.Exe", "PowerShell.EXE")
